title: Genetic PV/SST typing from extracellular mean waveforms
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: Allen-contributed CellExplorer ground truth: 136 training cells from 11 mice, 71 test cells from five disjoint mice. Six waveform scalars plus 81 normalized filtered mean-waveform samples. Genetically optotagged PV vs SST labels; class-balanced mouse accuracy. No ACG, ISI, firing rate, depth, genotype, optotag responses or test identifiers as predictors.

existing_reference.name: Fixed mouse-stratified three-fold choice between SVM and ExtraTrees
existing_reference.evidence: A: same input and mouse-aware training validation.
problems: Only five PV mice in the entire included source.
One genetic class per mouse leaves genetic-line/acquisition-cohort confounding.
Not comprehensive molecular typing or raw spike sorting.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: WaveMAP plus training-only supervised label transfer
candidates.information_match: Can use normalized waveforms, but unsupervised clusters are not genetic labels; fit UMAP only on training cells and map with allowed labels.

candidates.name: CEED waveform encoder
candidates.evidence: B: primary extracellular representation study; PMC posting in 2025 is not the publication year.
candidates.information_match: Mean-waveform-only adaptation differs from high-density spike views and augmentations; retraining and architecture choices need an explicit ablation.

candidates.name: PhysMAP waveform-only ablation
candidates.evidence: B: current domain specialist with optotagged comparisons.
candidates.information_match: Full multimodal method requires withheld spike-timing features; only a training-only waveform ablation is information-matched.

candidates.name: HIPPIE waveform-only encoder/probe
candidates.evidence: B for current multimodal method; D for clean off-the-shelf matched claim.
candidates.information_match: Full checkpoint needs ISI/ACG plus technology conditioning; model card lists CellExplorer and Allen Visual Coding pretraining, making test-unit overlap audit essential.

candidates.name: TabICLv2 / TabPFN-3.5
candidates.information_match: 87 numerical inputs fit; same fixed mouse folds and class-balanced mouse validation must be used.

recommended_next_comparator: Prospective waveform-only WaveMAP/CEED-style features plus a regularized supervised head and modern tabular challenger; preserve SVM/trees. Use no pretrained HIPPIE checkpoint until source-unit overlap is audited.
switching_assessment: ADD matched waveform-only challengers, medium priority, Tier B/C. Do not substitute PhysMAP/HIPPIE full multimodal scores or infer a winner from generic cell-type classification. HIPPIE is current and relevant but particularly exposed to this source.
limitations: Scarce mice and source cohort confounding limit genetic interpretation.
Restoring ACG/ISI/depth would expand the task information, not merely modernize the comparator.
Pretrained HIPPIE includes CellExplorer and Allen sources; identical-unit overlap is unresolved.
Allen source bytes remain subject to research/noncommercial terms, independently of code licenses.
Direct PhysMAP/HIPPIE publisher access was partly blocked; author repository/model card and indexed primary extracts were available.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
